# xterm.js (vendored)

The dashboard's live task terminal uses these files. The local server serves them at `/static/…`, so the page loads no code from outside.

| File | Package | Version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `xterm.js`, `xterm.css` | `@xterm/xterm` | 6.0.0 |
| `addon-fit.js` | `@xterm/addon-fit` | 0.11.0 |

Both are MIT licensed (see the LICENSE files). Checked against the npm `dist.integrity` hash when copied.
To update: download the package tarballs from the npm registry, check their integrity, and copy the same files.
